description: Save the research as a DRAFT in the dashboard Inbox, after the user approved it. It becomes a research only when someone creates it there. Paths are page paths starting with / (no host), with :name for the parts that change. Expected paths recorded and saved beforehand as plan-<n> (n = the task's position in tasks, from 1) are uploaded with it.

basis.description: What the research came from: real visitor data, virtual user data, or neither (the user's question or the code)

findingIds.description: Ids of the findings it answers, from research_context

hypotheses.description: Team only, never shown to participants: what the team expects to go wrong, one per item, 1–3 usually. The report judges each one. Each must be something these tasks can confirm or rule out

copy.description: The invite line, short. No duration — the card shows minutes

page.description: Page glob where visitors are invited

minutes.description: Minutes the whole session takes (tasks and questions). Shown on the invite card and the start screen

purpose.description: Shown to participants (invite card and start of the study): one or two sentences, in their words, on what they will help with. Never the team's evidence, suspicions or hypotheses

title.description: The question, as the participant reads it

start_screen.description: What participants read before the first task

click_text.description: element_click: the exact visible text of the element

follow_up_questions.description: Asked right after this task, at most 2

title.description: The question, as the participant reads it

info_text.description: Required. The situation the participant is in and why they would do this, one or two sentences. Never names buttons, menus or pages

target_url.description: url_entry: the page path that means done

timer.description: time_on_page: seconds on the page that mean done

title.description: The goal, in the participant's words. Never names buttons, menus or pages

xpath.description: element_click: XPath that finds that element by its text

xpath_url.description: element_click: the page path where the click happens

name: research_save
